snippet.title: DeathSpank: Thongs of Virtue - Launch Trailer
snippet.description: The sequel to DeathSpank, this trailer shows new environments, enemies and loot for the next game! From the mind that created Monkey Island, DeathSpank: Thongs of Virtue is sure to make you laugh.
